verdict.rationale: Beamer documents feedback collection and prioritization, segmentation by user attributes for targeted messaging, and a HubSpot sync. None of the evidence says customer context (attributes, account data, activity) is shown alongside feedback items to guide prioritization. Segmentation and the CRM sync are adjacent features aimed at messaging, not at feedback context, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters
